en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town nestled among rolling hills and agricultural fields, taken from an elevated lookout. The foreground shows scattered buildings and a prominent larger structure with a tower, while patchwork fields and low mountains stretch into the distance under a dramatic cloudy sky. The reverse side is a classic divided‑back postcard layout with Hungarian text indicating the view is from the Flóra rest area in Pécs, along with publisher information and the printed price.
